summary: This bill mandates that environmental reviews for Central Valley Project enhancement projects be completed within one year of permit application submission, allowing for an extension with applicant approval or permit denial if the deadline is not met.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to expedite environmental reviews for Central Valley Project enhancement projects by setting a one-year deadline and outlining consequences for agencies that fail to meet it. This streamlining of the environmental review process, which includes NEPA and ESA requirements, would likely lead to less thorough environmental protection in favor of project development.
